The board warping estimated jointly with the radiometric camera (spline camera model) from the photographs of one session, in which each of the two calibration targets (rows) stayed in place while it was photographed with the three lenses (columns): the height of the printed page above its plane, a thin-plate spline through $5\times5$ nodes (dots), drawn as a surface over the page with the heights 50 times as large as lengths on the page (ticks in mm), coloured in bands of 0.5\,mm; positive heights lie towards the camera. The AprilGrid page is $979\times979$\,mm. The Siemens stars page is $1000\times1000$\,mm.
